calls.thesis: Value-hunt candidate in the AI sell-off: a non-AI name beaten down ~50% year-to-date by a political fight over housing affordability, while the business just had its most successful year ever.
calls.base_case: Record year: revenue up 27% YoY, Scores up 33%, Software up 19%, non-GAAP EPS up 43%, free cash flow over $1B up 40%; shares outstanding down 10% in 12 months.
calls.bull_case: Business keeps compounding while the political overhang fades; platform ARR up 72%, 156% net retention.
calls.bear_case: No FY27 guidance given; pricing transparency reduced (customised, private lender pricing) which reads badly in headlines; political fight continues.

calls.thesis: Crash on mortgage-scoring regulation/VantageScore risk is a high-conviction buying opportunity for long-term investors.
calls.base_case: DCF $1,153/share; forward P/E 17.5 — cheapest in years; 20%+ revenue growth, 52% operating margins, 56.5% ROIC hold.
calls.bull_case: Pricing power and moat persist despite regulation noise; re-rates back toward historic premium multiple.
calls.bear_case: Policy changes erode FICO's grip on mortgage scoring, capping price increases and compressing the 52% margins.
